To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the policy process was driven by a convergence of political interests, a strong policy champion, and a research process that communicated its findings in a way that was relevant to policy makers.

the policy was formulated because of: (a) research results that were communicated in a manner that addressed both technical and political concerns, (b) the political need to address a key policy issue and (c) a political champion who could advocate the policy in the right political circles.
policy change is the result of complex interplay between the political and technical environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how research can inform policy and practice.
how policy is developed in a low-income setting.
the process of policy formulation and implementation and how this is affected by the nature of the research process itself.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the research was important in policy change but that other factors were equally important and that research alone is rarely sufficient to drive policy change.
the policy was formulated and implemented because the research results were used by policy-makers to support their existing policy preferences.
the process of policy change was a combination of technical and political factors, but that technical factors were more important than political factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
policy formulation and implementation is driven by a complex set of factors.
the research process needs to be sensitive to political concerns as well as technical ones.
the research findings were important, but that the research was not sufficient to ensure that the findings were used and that other factors played a role in the policy change.
The main takeaway from our work is that

researchers need to be aware of the political context of the policy-making environment in order to ensure that the results are communicated in an effective way and also to understand the political context of policy implementation.
researchers need to understand the policy environment and to engage with it in order to ensure that their work is used.
researchers need to understand the policy environment and the political context in which they are working if they are to maximise the impact of their research.
